observed_2026_09_06.claim: Observed discovery coverage only; not yet a completeness claim for all municipal procurement.

planned_projection.invalid_identifier_policy: CIG-looking placeholders or formally invalid tokens remain observed source evidence but must not create canonical contract identities.
planned_projection.public_boundary: Only fields and attachments that independently pass the existing public-safety policy may enter public projections.

limitations: The server-rendered procurement index is an official discovery surface, but its observed 947 elements are not by themselves a claim of complete municipal procurement history.
The observed final page contains 2017 records; years before the observed index boundary require independent source discovery and reconciliation.
Record detail and attachment URLs must be captured from the official page rather than inferred when the source does not expose them.
Historical completeness must be measured by full page/year traversal and reconciliation with ANAC, not inferred from the presence of a section.
CIG-looking placeholders such as 0000000000 can occur in the public table and must not be promoted to contract identity without formal validation.
Attachments remain subject to the existing fail-closed privacy and document-serving policy before extraction or publication.
